# Pravdeep Kullar

> Forward Deployed Engineer and full-stack developer based in Ontario, Canada, with over 2 years of hands-on experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js, plus Python for ML. Works directly with client teams at Nx Growth Partners to scope AI and software problems into clear milestones and ship them, and was previously a full-stack developer at Mentera, a healthcare AI platform. Holds a graduate certificate in AI with Machine Learning from Humber Polytechnic (2026).

## Experience
- Forward Deployed Engineer, Nx Growth Partners (Feb 2026 to present). Custom software and AI development agency: AI agents, copilots, RAG and knowledge systems, custom web and mobile apps, and integrations into clients' existing stacks.
- Full-Stack Developer, Mentera (Jul 2024 to Dec 2025). Healthcare AI platform for private practices and medspas. Canvas side panel for Tera, the AI chat assistant; config-driven integration drawer covering 35 integrations; Next.js marketing site performance pass.
- Freelance Web Developer, Rosehill Design Build (2026). Next.js marketing site on Vercel; domain and DNS setup; client feedback rounds with the client's COO.
- Web Developer Intern, Rebelsnow (Jan 2024 to Jul 2024). Client e-commerce websites.

## Website services
Freelance website projects for small businesses in Ontario, alongside full-time front-end and full-stack roles. Every project starts with a free site review.
- [Website services](https://www.builtbyprav.com/services): website redesigns for Ontario small businesses. Fast, mobile-friendly sites that bring in more calls and quote requests. The free review covers the current site's speed on mobile and desktop, how it works on a phone, and how it shows up in Google.
- [Website redesign](https://www.builtbyprav.com/services/website-redesign): rebuilding an outdated or slow site around the one thing a visitor came to do: call, book, or ask for a quote. Built with Next.js and hosted on Vercel, keeping pages that already rank at the same address and redirecting the ones that change, so search traffic carries over.
- [WordPress migration](https://www.builtbyprav.com/services/wordpress-migration): moving off an outdated WordPress or PHP site onto a modern stack (Next.js on Vercel). Every page and form is rebuilt, every old URL that changes gets a permanent (301) redirect, and email settings are checked before the domain switches. Sites that publish every week or run a large WooCommerce shop are usually better off cleaning up the WordPress site they have.
- [Speed and local SEO](https://www.builtbyprav.com/services/speed-and-seo): measuring Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) in PageSpeed Insights, fixing what slows a site on phones, then measuring again. Also covers local search basics: the Google Business Profile, a name, area and phone number that match everywhere, and page titles that name the service and the area.
- [Website care](https://www.builtbyprav.com/services/website-care): edits, updates and hosting help after launch. Content changes such as hours, prices and photos, framework and security updates, checks that the site is up and forms still deliver, domain and DNS renewals, and a regular PageSpeed check.
